808	/** #werk-mc-follow: the conversation owns the card. Focusing a tab moves the map to
809	 *  wherever that conversation last was — home, if it never sent a turn. */
810	async function switchTo(name) {
811	  if (!tabs.has(name)) ensureTab(name)
812	  if (!tabs.get(name).loaded) await hydrateTab(name)
813	  deadNotices.delete(name)
814	  renderDeadBar()
815	  if (activeName === name) {
816	    renderTabStrip()
817	    return
818	  }
819	  const prev = tabs.get(activeName)
820	  if (prev) prev.logEl.hidden = true
821	  activeName = name
822	  touch(name)
823	  const tab = tabs.get(name)
824	  tab.logEl.hidden = false
825	  chatInput.value = tab.draft
826	  paintStatusUI(tab.status)
827	  if (tab.model) setModelSelect(tab.model)
828	  if (tab.context) renderContextFill(tab.context)
829	  saveTabsState()
830	  renderTabStrip()
831	  const at = tab.at ?? tab.home ?? 'root'
832	  if ((location.hash.slice(1) || 'root') !== at) location.hash = at
833	  else render()
834	}

836	/** Fetches one conversation's transcript fresh — used the first time a tab is shown, and
837	 *  again after its turn ends so a newly created card reference becomes a link. */
838	async function hydrateTab(name) {
839	  const tab = ensureTab(name)
840	  const { messages, status, model, context } = await (await fetch(`/api/chat/history?convo=${encodeURIComponent(name)}`)).json()
841	  tab.logEl.innerHTML = ''
842	  tab.bubbles.clear()
843	  tab.toolGroup = null
844	  for (const m of messages) addChat(tab, m)
